Task Summary: Review and fix the tracker Apps Script code
Remarks: Reviewed the Gemini-built Code.gs, form and sidebar. Task numbers now always take the highest id + 1, so one bad row can no longer block every new submission.

Task Summary: Update team list for staff changes
Remarks: Removed Lahiru, Aditha, Udara and JanithP from assignment (their tabs kept for history). Added Eshara and Senura.

Task Summary: Bulk Add tasks with check before import
Remarks: Paste many tasks at once. Every row is checked first and nothing is written until all rows pass.

Task Summary: Protect sheets while keeping Status editable
Remarks: Lock Sheets protects automated columns. Status, Developer Remark and SVN Committed stay editable on team tabs.

Task Summary: Write user guide, admin guide and handbook
Remarks: User guide, adding people, test plan, first run guide and the Master Log Handbook page.

Task Summary: Put tracker code under version control
Remarks: Code now lives in a git repository with history, plus a build step that turns the design system into a file Apps Script can use.

Task Summary: Redesign the task dashboard
Remarks: New OneSapro design for My Tasks and the sidebar: stats, filters, running task, bulk actions, comments and follow-up nudge.

Task Summary: Restyle task form and Bulk Add to match
Remarks: Form and Bulk Add dialog moved onto the same design system as the dashboard.

Task Summary: Save tasks even when Drive is unreachable
Remarks: A task with no attachments was failing because the Drive folder could not be opened. Tasks now always save; an upload problem shows as a warning.

Task Summary: Fix dropdowns rejecting tasks for new staff
Remarks: Old dropdown rules did not list the new team members, so every task assigned to them was refused. Dropdowns are rebuilt from the team list.

Task Summary: Store time spent as hours for KPIs
Remarks: Time spent was stored as a fraction of a day. It is now stored as decimal hours (2.5 = 2h 30m) and old text values are ignored instead of guessed.

Task Summary: Handle Sheets Tables and shifted columns
Remarks: Refresh Dropdowns works on tabs that are Google Sheets Tables, and a new check finds data sitting under the wrong headings.

Task Summary: Dashboard progress, retry, tooltips, shortcuts
Remarks: Progress on each card, errors with a Retry button, tooltips, keyboard shortcuts, and script errors shown on the page instead of a blank screen.

Task Summary: Admin check for web app files
Remarks: Admin > Check Web App Files shows whether each page file is present and complete, and which web app address is in use.

Task Summary: Fix time totals growing 24 times too big
Remarks: Saving time into a cell formatted as a duration multiplied the total by 24 on each save. Time is now always written as plain hours.

Task Summary: Move task to new tab when reassigned
Remarks: Changing Assigned Member on Master now moves the task to the new person tab and clears it from the old one.

Task Summary: Project README
Remarks: Readme for the tracker repository.

Task Summary: Fix impossible hours and add wide dashboard
Remarks: A calendar date in the time column showed as 1,110,242 hours. Added Admin > Check Time Column and a wide dashboard view inside the sheet.

Task Summary: Fix dead My Tasks link on the form
Remarks: The link pointed at an internal Google address. It now uses the saved web app URL.

Task Summary: Button loaders and task attachments on dashboard
Remarks: Buttons spin and ignore repeat clicks while saving. Opening a task shows what was asked and its attachments. Code done; waiting to be deployed and tested.

Task Summary: Bulk Add can log finished work with real dates
Remarks: Bulk Add accepts Date, Status, Completed Date and Time, and hours for work already done. Also fixes Check rows failing when a row had a deadline. Waiting to be deployed and tested.
